title: harvester output
description: Canonical machine-readable output contract for the harvester role. See agents/harvester.md Step 7 for the prose contract this mirrors.

kb_captures.description: Durable knowledge this role verified during its run. The engine makes the kb_capture calls; the role only decides. Optional -- omit or send [] to capture nothing.

summary.description: The lesson in at most 2 sentences, present tense, standing alone as current truth.

trigger.description: What kind of event produced this lesson. Never "describes the change".

content.description: Optional. Written only when it adds what the summary cannot hold (labelled sections: Context, Symptom, Cause, Rule/Fix, Tried (failed), Evidence). Content that repeats the summary is refused.

source_files.description: Files that make this claim checkable. At least one is REQUIRED -- SqliteProvider.capture() rejects an entry with no basis, because the freshness sweep can never stale it.

recall_cues.description: Phrases a future reader would search for to find this lesson.

error_signatures.description: Exact error strings that this lesson explains.
